sentence: The room's place work restates in the model's terms — the call to place the Spur [t07], rebuilding and choosing a spot [t09], bargaining borders and upkeep with neighbours [t10], repair and defence [t14], the call on the Warriors logo [t15], the move of work into Discord [t18], and celebrating the Spur's survival [t21] — but t17's downvote-button deliberation (c0103–c0121) carries subreddit-UI organizing the model lacks.
